data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to set and manage alarms on iOS and Android devices.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to set, cancel, and listen to alarms on iOS and Android. It handles audio playback, system volume control, vibrations, and notifications using native code.
use_when: You need to build a clock or alarm app with custom sounds and notifications.
You require alarms to trigger even when the app is in the background or terminated.
avoid_when: You only need basic background task execution without user-facing alarms.
strengths: Supports custom audio assets, looping, and vibrations.
Handles volume control and fading settings.
Provides event streams for tracking alarm states and updates.
weaknesses: Requires manual native setup for both iOS and Android.
Some features behave differently depending on the operating system.
data.setup_notes: Requires following specific iOS and Android installation guides for native permissions and capabilities.
